title: The Canon of Added Weight
summary: A canon for students past the middle courses on heaping weight upon blow and foe until the exchange is lost to the lighter.

title: Compendium of Gravity Fields
summary: A compendium on spreading qi as a field in which weight is multiplied and every step and swing is made to drag.

title: Charter of Dropping Stone
summary: A charter on calling heavy masses down from above onto a single point with the user standing guarded beneath.

title: The Lodestar Treatise
summary: A treatise on becoming the fixed centre of a field of pull around which foes and blows are made to turn.

title: The Ponderous Tide Course
summary: A course on rolling slow waves of added weight over a foe that rise and fall until its stance gives way.

title: Code of the Sinking Domain
summary: A code for a domain where everything within sinks toward the ground and cannot rise without the user's leave.
